capabilities: Open Markdown, PDF, and EPUB files in a reader with table of contents and adjustable appearance
Highlight passages and write annotations collected in a reading notebook
Ask AI models about selected passages and follow citations back to the source
Export excerpts, annotations, and conversations as Markdown notes with links to the source
Browse and fetch books from a Z-Library mirror or a WeRead bookshelf
disambiguation: Not only a PDF or EPUB viewer; it centers on annotation and AI Q&A with export back into Markdown notes.
extras: Desktop-only and requires Obsidian 1.11.4 or later; the full user guide is only in Chinese. A prior install with the separate banana-reader plugin ID must be disabled before enabling this one. The WeRead integration may change or become unavailable; Z-Library is an unofficial integration. PDF selection needs a text layer; no OCR. Interface supports English and Simplified Chinese.
motivation: The project brings reading, thinking, and note-taking together in Obsidian, with links back to the original text.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in reader for PDF and EPUB with highlighting, annotation review, and AI questions tied back to the source text.

relations.evidence: Early interaction references include Gloss and Qiaomu Reader.
Early interaction references include Gloss and Qiaomu Reader.
configure your WeRead API key under Book sources, then switch the bookshelf to your WeChat Reading shelf
search and download books through a configured Z-Library mirror using your own account

requires.name: AI model service (OpenAI-compatible, Anthropic, or Gemini)

summary: Reading workspace that opens Markdown, PDF, and EPUB files for highlighting, annotating, asking AI models about passages, and exporting notes with source links.
